summary: An ambient synth firmware with basses, pads and plucks driven by a repeating generative Euclidean sequencer, with one sequencer track and eight voices.
features: Two oscillators with classic waves or three user sample slots
Euclidean patterns with probability, direction, interval, chaos and rhythm variations
Root, scale and range settings; optional scale-only keyboard
Three delay types, six reverbs, tape wow and flutter, chorus
Named patch list with favourites; browser player and sample uploader
Current release not yet verified on a physical FM-1
